draft.subject: Heavy weather forecast – route to Rotterdam – ECMWF IFS 20 Jan 00z
draft.body:
Dear Captain,

The office has seen the new ECMWF IFS forecast run of 20 Jan 00z. Heavy weather lies ahead on the remaining route to Rotterdam from 20 Jan 1800 UTC through 25 Jan 0600 UTC: winds up to Beaufort 10 (about 53 kn) and seas up to 8.6 m, sea on the quarter/following.

Please confirm the forecast specifics. Your weather routing service's advice and your own judgement come first, and the office supports whatever you decide.

Please advise if the ETA changes.

Take care of the ship and crew.

Kind regards,

Operations
